name: New World Albany Receipt
description: This receipt is issued by New World and identifies the store as New World Albany, 219 Don McKinnon Drive, Auckland, New Zealand, operated by J & J Eden Ltd. The header contains the supermarket branding, store location, telephone number, online shopping information, and customer support messaging. The receipt records the purchase of Roasted Salted Almonds and Hazelnuts, both sold by weight with price overrides applied to their original per-kilogram prices. The financial section records a subtotal of $8.54, GST of $1.28, and a final balance of $9.82. The customer paid $12.50 in cash, with a rounding adjustment of -$0.02 and $2.70 change returned. The footer contains the cashier name, transaction date and time, tax invoice designation, GST registration number, and confirmation that displayed prices are GST inclusive.
